card.title: Borrowed Authority
card.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 projects leadership; A3 adopts crew preference as A's decision; A5 rushes to announce B's next norm first.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 eleven contradicts A1 twelve; A3 revises the claim; B4 early Friday custom prompts A5 preemptive endorsement.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 represent practical crew habits that constrain a new leader.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 further custom to preserve authority through cooperation rather than insistence.
